summary.name: Nib Unlocker
summary.one_liner: A paid Mac app that attempts to convert compiled .nib and .storyboardc files (iOS/UIKit) back into editable .xib and .storyboard files for Xcode's Interface Builder.
use_cases: Recovering an editable .xib from a compiled .nib file
Opening a compiled .storyboardc in Xcode as a .storyboard
Restoring lost interface files for an iOS/UIKit project
Editing interface layouts in Interface Builder when source files are missing
summary.what_it_does: The app attempts to restore a compiled .nib or .storyboardc file and output a .xib or .storyboard file that Xcode's Interface Builder can edit. It converts compiled .nib files to .xib. It converts compiled .storyboardc files to .storyboard, a capability the developer announced in the 1.1 update. The page describes it as easy to use and super fast. It is listed as supporting iOS, UIKit-based files only.
notable: Converts compiled .nib to .xib for Interface Builder
caveats: Priced at USD 11.99 on the Mac App Store
Only for Mac; requires macOS 10.13 or later
Only iOS/UIKit-based files are supported and conversion is an attempt, so results may be imperfect
